ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular white patch on the far-left lobe tip; smaller, mottled white patch on the far-right lobe tip; numerous discrete white circular points (radiating scars) distributed across the dark medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch at the center of the fluke with a sharp angular vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; includes a significant jagged indentation/notch on the inner-left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the peduncle base transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the outer distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixels (barnacle scars/colonies) lining the entire outer perimeter and both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple diagonal, parallel white linear markings (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged excision/irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive barnacle encrustations visible along the outer margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive large circular white mark located in the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.
